notice: RESEARCH ONLY — V3 tests quarterly archived IDX snapshots with same-fiscal-period year-over-year comparisons; it is not an investment recommendation and is not approved for execution.
fundamental_update_frequency: quarterly snapshots sampled from the official IDX Financial Data and Ratio archive for March, June, September, and December
growth_period_alignment: compare cumulative sales and profit attributable to owners only with the same fiscal-statement month one calendar year earlier
growth_eligibility: current and comparison observations must have valid FS Date values with the same month and exactly one year of separation; prior value must be positive
policy_addendum: V1 and V2 remain preserved and are not overwritten.
V3 changes only the frequency and fiscal-period matching of the fundamental observations; all portfolio construction settings remain frozen.
A snapshot becomes usable only from the next month, preventing use of future archive information.
The price-only comparator uses the identical decisions, universe, portfolio construction, evaluation window, and cost assumptions.
